stories.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's new temporary leader will announce the company's financial results on Tuesday. People are curious what she will say about the company's problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own Nvidia stock. Unless you depend on Nvidia products for your business, there's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
stories.simple_summary: California's government is suing OpenAI because an AI tool caused problems that hurt people. This is one of the first times a court is trying to hold an AI company responsible for damage caused by its AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters because it may force AI companies to be more careful. For now, it's mostly a legal case that probably won't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions
stories.simple_summary: Apple is testing a new idea where your phone limits how many times you can use the most powerful AI features each day, like how a store might limit how much free coffee you can get. Simple Siri commands will stay unlimited.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use an iPhone, you might notice limits on fancy AI features later this year. Regular voice commands should still work normally.

stories.title: OpenAI wants to stop deepfakes from overwhelming child abuse tiplines
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a tool to help police and investigators tell the difference between real child abuse images and fake ones made by computers. This helps them find actual crimes faster.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect you, but it helps keep children safer online. It's good news for law enforcement and child protection.

stories.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
stories.simple_summary: A former president said that the old Nvidia boss's relationship problems did not hurt national security. Intelligence officials had a different opinion.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly political news about one company executive. It doesn't affect your business or daily life.

stories.title: Nvidia’s board is reportedly ‘not considering’ hiring Jensen Huang back
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's leadership board says they are not planning to bring back their old boss as CEO. They want to finish investigating what happened with him first.
stories.why_it_matters: This is company news that matters mostly to investors and Nvidia employees. It doesn't affect you unless you work there or own Nvidia stock.

stories.title: Sam Altman on Nvidia without Jensen Huang: the industry will be ‘fine’
stories.simple_summary: The leader of OpenAI said that Nvidia and the AI industry will do fine even though Nvidia's former boss stepped down.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly comment from one tech leader to another. Regular AI users probably won't notice any difference.

stories.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
stories.simple_summary: Police reported that bad actors used a freely available hacking tool to break into computer networks very quickly, taking less than three hours to get inside systems.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business, you should ask your computer person whether your network is protected against this kind of attack. This shows hackers are using AI tools to work faster.

stories.title: Jordan Belfort’s new AI voice startup, Tone, wants to sell like the ‘Wolf of Wall Street’
stories.simple_summary: A famous salesman is starting a company that uses AI to make a voice that can sell things like he does. He says it's almost as good as a real top salesman already.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use salespeople, pay attention. AI voices might handle some routine sales calls in the future, though this is mostly hype for now.

stories.title: OpenAI will embed safety researchers to investigate AI subversion
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is bringing in outside researchers to check whether its AI tools try to trick people or misbehave in sneaky ways. Some people worry these researchers might not be completely independent in their checking.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows OpenAI is trying to catch problems with its AI. It doesn't affect you directly, but it's good that someone is watching out for bad behavior.

stories.title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is adding tools to ChatGPT to block it from being used for child abuse material. If someone tries this, their account gets locked for 24 hours as a warning.
stories.why_it_matters: This helps keep children safe. If you use ChatGPT, this change protects you from criminal misuse and keeps the service cleaner.

stories.title: Anthropic promises to pursue humanity's benefit. Its IPO filing gives it wiggle room
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, an AI company, says it will help humanity but its legal paperwork gives it flexibility to change that goal later if needed. The company is planning to sell stock to the public.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to investors. For regular users, it means the company has room to change direction, so don't assume one promise is locked in forever.
